subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a provenance-preserving immutable/container official-plugin install path outside the mutable runtime state mount, and what package root plus trust-record storage should define that boundary?
rationale: The source failure path is clear, but deciding how external channel plugins earn trusted state access changes a security boundary and likely a deployment/config contract.

options.title: Design Immutable Official Plugin Root
options.body: Add or document an official install/provenance root that can be baked into an image while mutable runtime state and config remain mounted separately.

options.title: Keep Current Snapshot-State Contract
options.body: Document that self-hosted images must ship and mount the same complete OpenClaw state directory, accepting that common immutable-container mounts remain unsupported.

options.title: Decline New Trust Path
options.body: Close the request as not planned and keep trusted state limited to bundled plugins or installer-proven records in the active state directory.

recommendation.title: Design Immutable Official Plugin Root
recommendation.body: Add or document an official install/provenance root that can be baked into an image while mutable runtime state and config remain mounted separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned on the issue and already framed the fail-closed official-plugin provenance boundary in the discussion.
